commands.dashboard.description: Points you to the dashboard where you can configure the bot settings for your server
dashboard.reply: Setup Astro and configure all of its settings on the {emoji} [`Dashboard`]({link})
help.title: {emoji} Help
help.description: Astro is a bot that focuses on the voice aspect of Discord, and takes it to the next level with some quality features.
help.features.title: Features
help.features.content:
Astro provides the following features:
{generatorEmoji} *Temporary voice channels*
{voiceRoleEmoji} *Voice roles*
{interfaceEmoji} *Interfaces*
{templateEmoji} *Templates*
To find out all the cool things you can do with Astro, take a look at the [`Guides`]({guidesLink})!
help.setup.title: Setup & Configuration
help.setup.content: Use the {emoji} [`Dashboard`]({link}) to setup Astro and configure its settings!
help.errors.title: Errors & Issues
help.errors.content: The {emoji} [`Dashboard`]({link}) also shows all the errors Astro encounters when working in your server. If something is not working as expected, check the dashboard!
help.support.title: Support
help.support.content: You can join the {emoji} [`Support server`]({link}) to ask questions if something is not quite clear to you!
help.open_source.title: Open Source
help.open_source.content: Astro is now open source! You can find the code on [`GitHub`]({githubLink}) and a story of the project on my [`blog article`]({blogLink})
help.footer: Thank you for using Astro • shard {shardId}/{shardTotal} • pod {pod}/{totalPods}

Your server has exceeded the maximum amount of voice roles.

Your generator has a fallback generator configured, but ultimate is required to use it.

configuration_error.premium_auto_private:
Your generator has automatic private chat creation enabled, but ultimate is required to use it.
Either upgrade to ultimate or disable private chat creation!
configuration_error.premium_auto_waiting:

configuration_error.premium_creation_cha:
